rules: AfriAI-generated apps and websites MUST be composed from reusable partials.
Generators orchestrate partials; they MUST NOT contain giant product-specific templates.
Each partial MUST have one responsibility and be independently testable.
Product-specific configuration MUST be separated from reusable implementation partials.
Shared partials MUST NOT import product-specific feature logic.
Feature partials MUST declare their dependencies explicitly.
Generated artifacts MUST remain reproducible from generator inputs plus partial versions.
Partial changes MUST be verifiable without requiring a full APK or deployment rebuild.
